proposal.scope_review: Ordinary category-B passenger-car learner; no specialist vehicle qualification required.
proposal.learning_objective: Support a conscious casualty while awaiting the emergency services, without unnecessary movement or oral intake.
proposal.scenario: A conscious adult remains seated where found in a safe off-road area after a collision. The scene is secured and help has already been called; no immediate danger or life-threatening bleeding is present. These facts are stated, not inferred from the still image.
proposal.novelty_review: Existing PLS, CPR, bleeding, choking and initial protect-alert questions concern different conditions or urgent interventions. This asks appropriate waiting care for a conscious casualty after the alert.

fr.question_text: Les lieux sont sécurisés et les secours prévenus. Cette personne blessée est consciente, sans danger immédiat ni saignement important. En attendant, que puis-je faire ?
fr.answer_c: Rester près d’elle et la rassurer.
fr.answer_d: La faire marcher pour la réchauffer.
fr.explanation: Je la protège du froid et la rassure. Je ne lui donne rien à boire et ne la déplace pas inutilement.

en.question_text: The scene is safe and help has been called. This injured person is conscious, with no immediate danger or major bleeding. While waiting, what can I do?
en.answer_d: Make them walk to warm up.
en.explanation: I keep the conscious person warm and reassure them while waiting for help. I do not give them drinks or move them unnecessarily.

fr.b: Incorrect : ne rien donner à boire.

proposal.scope_review: Ordinary category-B passenger-car learner; no specialist vehicle qualification required.
proposal.learning_objective: Interpret a left-only directional arrow in a short dedicated turn lane.
proposal.scenario: Driver is in a short left-turn pocket beside the through lane before a junction. A single clear left-only directional arrow is painted in this pocket. This is not a lane-reduction layout; the through lane continues. No manoeuvre or priority decision is asked.
proposal.novelty_review: Existing B21 and C24 questions interpret vertical signs. This targets a short turn lane’s pavement marking, not a new rendering of a covered sign code.

fr.question_text: Je suis dans cette courte voie spécialisée. Quelle direction indique la flèche peinte dans ma voie ?
fr.explanation: La flèche directionnelle de cette voie indique seulement la gauche. Elle ne comporte pas de branche autorisant à continuer tout droit.

en.question_text: I am in this short dedicated turn lane. Which direction does the arrow painted in my lane indicate?
en.explanation: This lane’s directional arrow points left only. Its single branch indicates a left turn; it has no additional branch permitting travel straight ahead.

fr.b: Incorrect : la flèche pointe à gauche.
fr.d: Incorrect : la flèche n’a qu’une direction.

en.a: Incorrect: there is no straight-ahead branch.
en.d: Incorrect: this arrow shows only one direction.
